name: Polls & surveys
summary: Ask viewers a question on the TV and collect answers with the remote.
description: A poll or survey layout where viewers answer with the remote control directly on the TV screen. Advertisers gather quick feedback and sentiment during the ad. This template is shown as design mock-ups only.
